retrievalProfile.description: Use for creating moody, low-key portraits featuring a large foreground subject and a smaller, ethereal figure emerging from mist in the background.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic composition featuring a close-up, side-profile portrait of a man in the foreground, contrasted with a full-body ethereal woman standing in a cloud of mist in the background, set against a dark, nocturnal environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject occupies the left half of the frame in a large scale.
Background subject is positioned on the right, appearing smaller and surrounded by fog.
Warm rim lighting on the foreground subject contrasts with the cool, white mist of the background.
Typography is anchored in the upper right quadrant, overlapping the background scene.
coreInvariants: Side-profile orientation for the primary subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is a large-scale bust-up profile on the left; secondary subject is a small full-body figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary subject's face and the bright white mist surrounding the secondary figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large profile on the left, moves across the dark space to the misty figure on the right, then up to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the center and bottom right to emphasize the subjects and the mist.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale blue for the mist and the secondary figure's dress.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber/gold rim lighting on the primary subject and vibrant pink/red for the script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights; saturation is low except for the title text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary colors except for the specific accent text.

letterConstructionRules: Ascenders and descenders are elongated and flourished.
Secondary text is a clean, geometric sans-serif for legibility.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' and 'N' in the script have extended, sweeping swashes that underline the name.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast script paired with a neutral, wide-tracked sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule or swash underlining the main title.

preserve: Color contrast between pink and gold

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant script style.
Matches the clean, geometric feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man in profile on the left, with a dark background. On the right, include a small figure of a woman in a white dress standing in a dense, glowing white mist.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, elegant pink script title in the top right corner, with a smaller gold sans-serif subtitle directly underneath it.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground subject in profile?
Is the background figure surrounded by mist?
Is the script text high-contrast and flourished?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific face of the artist
Do not include the white price sticker/label

mustAchieve: Soft-focus ethereal quality in the background
Sharp, dramatic lighting on the foreground profile

postGenerationChecks: Check for clear separation between foreground and background subjects.
Ensure the mist looks volumetric and not like a flat gradient.
Verify the typography is legible against the background.
Confirm the color palette remains moody and nocturnal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large-scale low-key profile portrait with a small-scale ethereal figure in mist, topped with high-contrast decorative script.
